schedule.title: Welcome Drinks + Rehearsal Dinner
schedule.description: Join us for an evening of warm conversation, light bites, and a first toast to the weekend ahead. Come as you are — we can't wait to welcome you.

schedule.title: Ceremony
schedule.description: We invite you to gather with us as we exchange vows surrounded by those we love most. Please arrive a few minutes early so you can settle in before we begin.

schedule.title: Reception
schedule.description: Following the ceremony, celebrate with dinner, dancing, and drinks under the stars. Your presence is the greatest gift — we hope you'll stay late and dance with us.

schedule.title: Brunch
schedule.description: One last gather before we say goodbye — coffee, pastries, and lingering goodbyes. Come for a relaxed morning and help us send off the weekend in style.
